papers.reason: cross-sectional survey of health-professional students' GenAI use; its instrument (4 domains, a self-perceived GenAI maturity index, Likert-scale benefit/risk items) measures attitudes, readiness, and self-disclosure of entering personal data into GenAI, not a scheme for classifying disclosure, attribution, or provenance of an AI-assisted produced artifact
